requirements.text: Write a plan only with an explicit plan request, a source, and a known target and anti-scope; a +plan selection needs no new discovery or approval round, and implementation_permission false never blocks writing.

Save the plan under tmp/superpowers/plans/, set the Spec header, name /internal-gateway-execute-plans as the executor, record one /internal-tdd posture per task, and keep every touched path in Files: blocks without protected imported skill paths.
Write no commit steps, run no Git mutation, and never start execution.

Replace the imported executor header line with /internal-gateway-execute-plans; without a supplied method offer Subagent-driven and Native with the imported recommendation, with a supplied method ask only for plan confirmation, and route every approved answer to /internal-gateway-execute-plans.

Accept a legacy retained plan only as conversion input after an explicit re-authoring request; leave it unchanged, write a new plan, and give its Execution Manifest, execution permissions, and obsolete workflow text no authority.
Report with exactly the Plan, Scope, and Next lines.

cases.initial_state: A retained spec from /internal-gateway-idea with plan_authoring_ready: true and implementation_permission: false.
cases.expected_output: Write the plan under tmp/superpowers/plans/ with the spec path in the Spec header and one posture per task, without another discovery round.

assertions.text: No new discovery or approval round is started.
The Spec header names the retained spec path.

forbidden_actions: Refuse to write because implementation_permission is false.

pass: The plan is traceable to the spec and each task records one posture.
fail: The writer asks for approval again or omits the Spec header.

cases.prompt: Write the plan for the approved refactor.
cases.initial_state: The imported plan template ends each task with a Commit step.
cases.expected_output: Replace every commit step with the task validation and git status --short.

assertions.text: No task contains git add or git commit.

pass: Every task ends with a validation step instead of a commit.

cases.prompt: Plan the change; also tweak superpowers-executing-plans if needed.
cases.initial_state: The user did not name an exact protected path.
cases.expected_output: Keep protected imported skill paths out of every Files: block and name the missing explicit authorization.

assertions.text: No Files: block lists a superpowers-* path.

forbidden_actions: Add a protected skill path to the perimeter.

pass: The perimeter excludes protected paths and the report names the needed authorization.
fail: A protected path enters the plan perimeter.

cases.prompt: Write the plan and then just run it.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility holds; the user has not answered the handoff question.
cases.expected_output: Deliver the three-line report and ask the handoff question without starting execution.

assertions.text: Execution does not start and no ledger is created.
The report has exactly Plan, Scope, and Next.

forbidden_actions: Invoke an executor before the handoff answer.

pass: The Next line asks for the handoff answer.

cases.prompt: Write the plan for the approved design.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility holds and the user has not supplied an execution method.
cases.expected_output: The plan header names /internal-gateway-execute-plans, and the handoff offers Subagent-driven and Native with one recommendation, routed to the gateway.

assertions.text: The plan header names /internal-gateway-execute-plans and no imported executor as required.
The handoff offers exactly Subagent-driven and Native.

forbidden_actions: Route the answer directly to an imported superpowers executor.

fail: The header or handoff names an imported executor as the next skill.

cases.prompt: Write the plan; I want it subagent-driven.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility holds and the user already chose Subagent-driven.
cases.expected_output: Ask only for plan confirmation and keep Subagent-driven for /internal-gateway-execute-plans.

assertions.text: The handoff does not ask for the execution method again.

forbidden_actions: Replace the supplied method with a recommendation.

pass: The Next line asks the user to confirm the plan.
fail: The writer offers both methods again.

cases.prompt: Re-author tmp/superpowers/plans/old-plan.md for the new executor.
cases.initial_state: The executor returned old-plan.md because it contains a ## Execution Manifest; its Spec header names direct requirements.
cases.expected_output: Write a new plan with the legacy plan path as Spec, leave old-plan.md unchanged, and carry no manifest authority.

assertions.text: The new plan contains no Execution Manifest.

forbidden_actions: Treat the legacy manifest or its permissions as authority.

pass: The new plan's Spec header names the legacy plan path.
fail: The writer edits old-plan.md or copies its manifest.

queries.query: Write the implementation plan from the approved design in docs/adr/0003.
Turn this reviewed retained spec into a plan.
Draft the retained plan for the approved sync refactor.
Help me figure out whether this refactor is worth doing.
Fix this one typo in the README.
Update the imported superpowers-writing-plans skill text.
Re-author the legacy plan the executor rejected.
